articles.title: Janmashtami 2026: Puja Timings, Muhurat, and Where NRIs Can Celebrate
articles.excerpt: Krishna Janmashtami falls on September 4 this year, with ISKCON temples across the US hosting midnight arati, kirtans, and free prasadam for the diaspora.
articles.image_caption: A Janmashtami celebration marking the birth of Lord Krishna. The Hindu festival falls on August 26–27 this year.
articles.nri_angle: Comprehensive guide for NRIs in the US celebrating Janmashtami, with specific temple events, timings, and locations across Boston, Bay Area, Dallas, and Southern California.

articles.title: Bollywood Child Star Mayur Verma Gave Up Fame to Run Restaurants in Wales
articles.excerpt: Once the highest-paid child actor in Hindi cinema, Verma moved to rural Wales in 2007 to support his wife Noori's culinary dreams — and never looked back.
articles.image_caption: A still related to the Bollywood films of the 1970s era. Former child star Mayur Verma, who played young Amitabh Bachchan in films like Muqaddar Ka Sikandar, now runs restaurants in Wales.
articles.nri_angle: Former Bollywood child star who relocated to rural Wales, built a restaurant business with his wife, and raised bilingual children in the Welsh countryside.

articles.title: India's Gen Alpha Walks Out of Class, Demanding Schools That Actually Work
articles.excerpt: Children across at least 10 Indian states are protesting crumbling school buildings, absent teachers and unsafe conditions, building on the Gen Z exam-leak movement that toppled an education minister.
articles.image_caption: School students in India. A growing wave of Gen Alpha protests across at least 10 states is demanding basic infrastructure in government schools.
articles.nri_angle: The protests spotlight the gap between India's education ambitions and ground reality in government schools, raising questions for diaspora families with ties to rural India.

articles.title: Indian-American Voters Show Highest Enthusiasm Among Asian Americans Ahead of 2026 Midterms
articles.excerpt: The 2026 AAPI Voter Survey finds 92% of Indian-American registered voters plan to vote in November, with 66% backing Democratic candidates for Congress.
articles.image_caption: Indian-American voters show the highest enthusiasm among Asian Americans ahead of the 2026 midterm elections.
articles.nri_angle: Indian Americans are emerging as one of the most politically active subgroups among Asian Americans, with the highest voting enthusiasm and strongest partisan preferences ahead of the November midterms.

articles.title: India-US Trade Deal Awaits Preferential Tariff Framework, Says Piyush Goyal
articles.excerpt: Commerce Minister says negotiations on the first tranche are closed but India will not finalize until Washington guarantees a tariff edge over Vietnam, Bangladesh, and other competitors.
articles.image_caption: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said India has closed negotiations on the first tranche of the India-US trade deal but awaits a preferential tariff framework from Washington.
articles.nri_angle: Trade deal outcome directly affects Indian exporters and NRI business interests; preferential tariffs could boost sectors employing millions across India.

articles.title: Indian American Teen Kiran Reddy Crowned Miss Teen USA 2026, Makes History for Georgia
articles.excerpt: The 18-year-old from Douglas, Georgia, becomes the first Indian American and the first Georgian to win the Miss Teen USA title.
articles.nri_angle: First Indian American to win Miss Teen USA, representing growing visibility of Indian-origin Americans in mainstream American culture.

articles.title: Adobe Names Anil Chakravarthy as Next CEO in Leadership Shift to AI Era
articles.excerpt: The Indian-origin executive will take over as president and CEO on December 1, succeeding Shantanu Narayen after nearly two decades, as Adobe faces mounting competition from AI-native rivals.
articles.image_caption: Adobe's board named Indian-origin executive Anil Chakravarthy as the company's next president and CEO, effective December 1, 2026.
articles.nri_angle: Chakravarthy's appointment continues the notable trend of Indian-origin executives leading major American technology companies, succeeding fellow Indian-American Shantanu Narayen.

articles.title: HarperCollins India to Publish Sonia Gandhi's Memoir After Penguin Row
articles.excerpt: The long-awaited political memoir 'Belonging: A Journey of Love' will be released in India on November 10 after Penguin Random House India exited the deal amid a dispute over editorial changes.
articles.image_caption: Sonia Gandhi, whose memoir will be published by HarperCollins India.
articles.nri_angle: The memoir offers an insider's perspective on India's political history spanning five decades, touching on events that shaped the Indian diaspora's understanding of their homeland.

articles.title: Tata Trusts Cleared in 1989 Share Transfer Probe, Removing Hurdle to Tata Sons Chairman Search
articles.excerpt: Maharashtra's Charity Commissioner closed a complaint over the transfer of 833 Tata Sons shares, a ruling that frees the Trusts to resume internal governance at a critical leadership juncture.
articles.image_caption: The Tata Trusts office signage. The Maharashtra Charity Commissioner dismissed a complaint about a 1989 Tata Sons share transfer, clearing the way for the Tata Sons chairman search.
articles.nri_angle: The Tata Group's leadership transition is closely watched by NRI investors given Tata companies' significant presence in global markets and the group's philanthropic reputation across the diaspora.

articles.title: Belgian PM's Chocolate India Gate Melts En Route as India and Belgium Reset Ties After 20 Years
articles.excerpt: Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever's gift of a chocolate India Gate sculpture for PM Modi did not survive the journey, but the two leaders used his first visit in two decades to sign defense and trade agreements.
articles.image_caption: Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever during his visit to India, the first by a Belgian head of government in 20 years. A chocolate replica of the India Gate that he brought as a gift melted en route due to the heat.
articles.nri_angle: The India-Belgium diplomatic reset and India-EU FTA talks could expand business and educational opportunities for the Indian diaspora in Europe.

articles.title: Pawan Kalyan Turns 55: How Martial Arts Built a Deputy Chief Minister's Discipline
articles.excerpt: The Telugu star-turned-politician marked his 55th birthday on September 2, capping a year in which he became the first Telugu person inducted into Japan's Takeda Shingen Clan while governing four ministries in Andhra Pradesh.
articles.image_caption: Pawan Kalyan, the Telugu actor and Deputy Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh, turned 55 on September 2, 2026.
articles.nri_angle: Pawan Kalyan's massive Telugu diaspora fanbase follows his political and cinematic career closely, and his martial-arts discipline resonates with NRI audiences interested in wellness and cultural pride.

articles.title: Nepal's First Woman Helicopter Captain Flies 100 Rescue Missions in Under a Week
articles.excerpt: Captain Priya Adhikari, 40, has been flying nearly continuously over Nepal's flood-ravaged Rasuwa district, pulling survivors from mudslides that have killed more than 1,000 people across Nepal and Tibet.
articles.image_caption: Captain Priya Adhikari, Nepal's first woman helicopter captain. The 40-year-old pilot has flown roughly 100 rescue missions in less than a week as floods and mudslides devastate the country.
articles.nri_angle: As a South Asian woman breaking barriers in high-altitude aviation, Adhikari's story resonates with diaspora audiences invested in stories of regional progress and resilience.

articles.title: Operation Sindoor Commander Named First CEO of Ayodhya Ram Temple Trust
articles.excerpt: Retired Air Marshal Jeetendra Mishra, selected from over 5,500 applicants, takes charge of the Ram Janmabhoomi Trust as it seeks to restore credibility after a donations embezzlement scandal.
articles.image_caption: The Ram Temple in Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh. The Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust has appointed retired Air Marshal Jeetendra Mishra as its first CEO.
articles.nri_angle: Overseas donations were a significant part of the Ram Temple's construction fund, and the appointment of a professional CEO signals institutional accountability for the diaspora's contributions.

articles.title: NRI Deposits Hit Record $127 Billion as RBI Closes FCNR Scheme Ahead of Schedule
articles.excerpt: India's diaspora-focused dollar deposit scheme attracted nearly five times the amount raised in the 2013 iteration, pushing forex reserves toward $750 billion and prompting the RBI to close the window a month early.
articles.image_caption: Indian currency banknotes. NRI deposits under the FCNR(B) scheme reached a record $127 billion before the RBI closed the scheme ahead of schedule.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs deposited a record $127 billion through the FCNR(B) scheme, underscoring the Indian diaspora's financial clout and willingness to support India's currency in times of stress.

articles.title: Aditi Paudel, 17, Becomes Japan's First Literacy Ambassador
articles.excerpt: The Nepali-origin high school senior in Tokyo has been appointed by the World Literacy Foundation, becoming the first ambassador from Japan in the program's 12-year history.
articles.image_caption: The World Literacy Foundation logo. The organization appointed Aditi Paudel, a 17-year-old high school senior in Tokyo, as Japan's first literacy ambassador.
articles.nri_angle: Paudel's story reflects the broader South Asian diaspora experience of navigating multiple languages and cultures while making a global impact, and her plans to support literacy in Nepal connect to diaspora giving-back.

articles.title: Sitharaman Pitches India as Defence and Tourism Hub in Chicago Meetings With US CEOs
articles.excerpt: The finance minister met executives from Hyatt, Shield AI, and ADM during a nine-day Canada-US visit that includes the G20 Finance Ministers meeting.
articles.nri_angle: Sitharaman addressed the Indian diaspora in Chicago and pitched India as an investment destination across defence, tourism, and agriculture sectors.

articles.excerpt: Indian American Impact is convening lawmakers and South Asian elected officials on September 2 to address a surge in hate targeting the community.

articles.title: Indian Americans Back Democrats by 3-to-1 Margin Ahead of 2026 Midterms, New Survey Finds

articles.nri_angle: Indian-American voters are poised to play an outsized role in the 2026 midterms, with high enthusiasm and strong Democratic preference driven partly by concerns over anti-Indian rhetoric and immigration policies.

articles.title: 51 Indian Nationals Killed Fighting for Russia as Death Toll Nearly Doubles in a Year
articles.excerpt: Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri confirms 227 Indians recruited into Russian armed forces, 139 discharged; families still await remains and compensation.
articles.image_caption: India has confirmed that 51 nationals recruited into the Russian armed forces have died, nearly double the toll reported to Parliament in December 2024.
articles.nri_angle: Indian nationals recruited abroad under false pretenses have been killed in a foreign war, raising urgent questions about protections for Indians seeking employment overseas.

articles.title: Sabyasachi Opens Lavish 26,000 Sq Ft Delhi Flagship With Met Jewellery Debut
articles.excerpt: India’s biggest luxury fashion store features a Kolkata-inspired design with 120 chandeliers and a Byzantine jewellery collection created with New York’s Metropolitan Museum of Art.
articles.image_caption: Fashion designer Sabyasachi Mukherjee, who has opened a 26,000 sq ft flagship store at The Citadel in New Delhi alongside his Met Museum jewellery debut.
articles.nri_angle: Sabyasachi draws 40% of revenue from the US with strong NRI demand, and the Met collaboration positions Indian craft as a global luxury force for diaspora consumers.

articles.title: Anti-Corruption Icon Anna Hazare Hospitalised in Mumbai With Viral Infection
articles.excerpt: The veteran social activist was admitted to Bombay Hospital after severe dehydration and a viral infection, with doctors monitoring his condition closely.
articles.image_caption: Anti-corruption activist Anna Hazare, who was admitted to Bombay Hospital in Mumbai with a viral infection and severe dehydration.
articles.nri_angle: Hazare's anti-corruption movement mobilised millions of Indians worldwide, and his health remains closely followed by the diaspora community.

articles.title: The ISRO Chief Who Led India to Mars and Never Stopped Dancing Kathakali
articles.excerpt: Dr. K. Radhakrishnan steered Mangalyaan to Mars on India's first attempt while maintaining a parallel life as a Kathakali performer and Carnatic vocalist.
articles.image_caption: Dr. K. Radhakrishnan, former ISRO Chairman who led India's Mars Orbiter Mission. He is also a trained Kathakali performer and Carnatic vocalist.

articles.excerpt: Mohan Bhagwat delivered a keynote on "universal oneness" to 6,000 attendees from 39 states and 29 countries as demonstrators rallied outside and U.S. religious freedom commissioners urged sanctions against the RSS.
articles.image_caption: RSS Sarsanghchalak Mohan Bhagwat, who addressed roughly 6,000 attendees at Madison Square Garden on August 29 as part of the organization's centenary-year international tour.
articles.nri_angle: The event at Madison Square Garden brought together 6,000 members of the Indian diaspora from 39 U.S. states and 29 countries, highlighting deep divisions within the community over the RSS and Hindu nationalism.

articles.title: How IIT Kanpur Graduate Satish Kumar Kaura Built Samtel Into a Rs 1,200-Crore Electronics Empire

articles.nri_angle: Seven-year-old Indian-origin boy Jivyan Dhruva continues a tradition of academic excellence among Indian diaspora families in the UK.

articles.title: Indian Army Pilots Execute Daring Helicopter Rescue at 18,600 Feet Near Nun Kun
articles.excerpt: Army Aviation crew evacuated a casualty from a steep Ladakh slope with no landing space, balancing the helicopter on one skid in fading daylight.
articles.image_caption: An Indian Army Aviation helicopter. Army pilots evacuated a casualty from 18,600 feet near the Nun Kun massif in Ladakh, operating at the edge of helicopter flight capability.
articles.nri_angle: The high-altitude rescue showcases Indian Army Aviation's operational capability in extreme Himalayan terrain, a source of pride for the global Indian diaspora.
